{"step":3,"file":"src/irc/core/irc.c","function":"irc_parse_message_tags","line":432,"var":"split","code":"split = g_strsplit(tags, ';', -1);","note":"The tags string is split into key/value fields, preserving a lone tag escape sequence inside a field."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/irc/core/irc.c","function":"irc_parse_message_tags","line":436,"var":"kv[1]","code":"kv = g_strsplit(*tmp, '=', 2);","note":"Each field is split on '=', so a tag with no '=' leaves kv[1] NULL while a tag with a trailing backslash keeps the escape character in the value slot when present."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/irc/core/irc.c","function":"unescape_tag","line":387,"var":"*tmp","code":"for (; *tmp != '\\0'; tmp++, tag++) { if (*tmp == '\\') { tmp++; switch (*tmp) { ... default: *tag = *tmp; break; } } else { *tag = *tmp; } }","note":"A lone trailing backslash advances tmp past the string terminator and the loop does not stop on that escape, causing incorrect parsing behavior in the tag value."}
]
